Game Overview

In Moving Fortress, the core idea is straightforward: survive the relentless peril of Moving Fortress as a train chef navigating deadly tracks. Master strategic maneuvers to dodge enemy tanks and prevent disasters. With intuitive controls and escalating challenges, this thrilling journey demands quick reflexes and sharp planning for high replayability and unyielding excitement.
